name: egm
description: Elephant-Goldfish Model: develop ideas with full context and review documents with fresh eyes. Kimi port of google/elephant-goldfish-model.
skillInstructions:
Kimi Code mapping for EGM skills:

- Subagents: use Kimi's `Agent` tool. Reviewer personas live in the plugin's `agents/` directory; their frontmatter `name` (egm-zoom-out, egm-design, ...) is the `subagent_type` to request. If that type is rejected, use `subagent_type: "explore"` and tell the subagent to read the persona file first.
- Fresh context is the point: never review a document in the main session.
- Structured gates: use `AskUserQuestion`.
- Task tracking: use `TodoList`.
- Artifacts: write briefs, drafts and reports with `Write`; do not paste long documents into chat.
- Entry points: /egm:brainstorm, /egm:draft, /egm:review, /egm:review-loop, /egm:resolve, /egm:lite, /egm:bootstrap, /egm:drift-report.

interface.shortDescription: Design with an elephant, review with a goldfish
interface.longDescription: Develop ideas with context and review documents with fresh eyes. The elephant holds your project context and drafts the specification; goldfish reviewers examine the draft and referenced source material without the earlier conversation, exposing unstated assumptions and blind spots. Includes brainstorm, draft, review, review loop, resolve, lite, bootstrap and drift report.
